runtimeScope: Stage replace_item actions on a cloned action plan and commit only after every nested tool succeeds. Propagate failed set_attribute receipts and defer accepted attribute callbacks until the whole replacement succeeds.

Carry unresolved replacement failures through Chat Completions, Responses, iteration and transport error returns. A successful replacement retry clears only its matching original owner. Repeated calls after a successful source removal and expansions locked by unit partitions retain their established owners.
Ask one clarification and hold the whole mixed request when a replacement is still rejected. Explain invalid quantity, unavailable catalog options or ambiguous source through controlled messages.

Preflight replacement addition IDs with the existing purchase validator before editing the cart. Preserve the original session if a replacement addition is filtered, requires options, or fails a cart limit.

Reuse the counted-purchase parser to resolve fully named replacement destinations with explicit configured options before applying additional purchases. Preserve compatible original options, quantity and note.
developmentFindings: The initial run failed11 cases. Nine reproduced runtime failures, including five quantities leaving prepared attribute changes, two ignored nested option receipts and two building-cart mixed-request failures. Two checkout fixture failures omitted the existing entry flag and are excluded from that reproduction count.
Two checkout fixtures initially called the normal cart route without its placedOrderOnly entry flag. The corrected fixtures exercise the existing checkout entry and assert the original state.

A recovery attempt exposed the existing mixed-replacement parser rejecting a fully named destination with an explicit beverage. Reusing the counted-purchase parser resolves canonical options and rejects uncovered suffixes.

The harness ignoreBusinessHours option presents scheduled products as available. A synthetic replacement accepted by that model-facing catalog was subsequently filtered by the purchase validator, leaving an empty cart on the previous host path. A preflight now requires every replacement addition ID before removal. Late missing-option and limit failures also return the original session.
The first compiled adapter lost static expect.arrayContaining when wrapping expect. Copying its static matchers fixed the adapter without changing runtime expectations.
limits: Provider responses, Meta, persistence, map quotes and order creation are simulated. Real-model wording and representative pilot outcomes require further measurement.
Unresolved replacement failures hold the entire mixed request and ask for a complete reformulation. A persistent selector and more cross-tool recovery cases remain pending.
The host preflight checks presence of replacement product IDs. Exact quantities and notes across multiple projected replacements need more cases.

Full replacement destinations support canonical configured options through the existing parser. Natural field-only phrases mixed with purchases and replacement kitchen-note suffixes require additional coverage.
Other update_item/remove_item rejections and initial owner validation for those tools remain pending.
Production promotion and generic Kamppo adaptation remain pending.
